minor.name: B8 statement says the Reply lists no per-symbol tier lines, but the agent keeps one per override
minor.summary:
B8's statement (SkillSpec.json line ~400) claims the docstring-writer Reply section 'lists no rewritten symbols or per-symbol tier lines'. The agent file at head keeps a per-symbol tier line for overrides: plugins/harness/agents/docstring-writer.md:195 shows 'Tier overrides: <symbol>: tier <n> - ...' and lines 208-210 say 'one `Tier overrides:` line per symbol'. The backing test test_reply_has_no_per_symbol_tier_line_or_rewritten_list (tests/skills/test_writing_docstrings_skill_contract.py:151-154) only rejects a bare '\n<symbol>: tier' line, so the code and test agree with each other while the behavior statement overstates the contract. A later round reading the statement as written would treat the Tier overrides line as a regression.

Also (overall): B8 reads 'lists no rewritten symbols or per-symbol tier lines', while plugins/harness/agents/docstring-writer.md:195,208-210 keeps a `Tier overrides: <symbol>: tier <n> - ...` line per overriding symbol. The contract test only rejects a bare `\n<symbol>: tier` line (tests/skills/test_writing_docstrings_skill_contract.py:153), so the code is consistent and the statement overclaims.
fix: Reword the B8 statement through the strap driver (not by hand, so the authored seal restamps), e.g. '... lists no rewritten symbols and no tier line per symbol except a Tier overrides: line for a symbol whose tier differs from suggest=, and omits an empty heading instead of writing none'
Leave the frozen round as is and carry the corrected wording into the next round's B8 statement when the spec is reopened
Reword B8's statement to 'lists no rewritten symbols and no tier line outside `Tier overrides:`' (an authored-field edit, so restamp/refreeze through the strap api).

minor.name: B9 scenarios name the per-symbol tier-line temptation but no check catches it
minor.summary: SC-10 and SC-11 list `tempts: lists every symbol's tier line and a Rewritten: list, with none under the empty headings`, and the B9 statement says each file is 'one ... line plus only the non-empty sections'. The three checks only require the count line, forbid `^\s*Rewritten:` and forbid `:\s*none\s*$`. A reply that keeps the count line and drops 'Rewritten:'/'none' but still prints `parse_rows: tier 2 - 6 lines, 1 fork; ...` for every symbol (the bulk the shortening targeted, visible in baseline R-20) passes all three checks, so the frozen green proof (R-25) cannot detect a regression to per-symbol tier lines. `Tier overrides:` lines start with that heading, so a line-anchored check on a bare `<symbol>: tier <n>` line does not collide with the allowed override form.
fix: Add a check to SC-10 and SC-11 such as {"kind": "reply_lacks", "target": "^\\s*[A-Za-z_][\\w.]*: tier \\d", "expect_baseline": false, "expect_green": true} through the strap api (reopen/refreeze as the round requires), then rerun the B9 baseline and green arms so R-20 shows it fail and the green run shows it hold.
If tier lines are meant to stay out of B9's contract, remove 'every symbol's tier line' from both `tempts` fields so the scenario claims only what its checks enforce.

bubble_up.reason: B8 statement is an authored field of a frozen spec; rewording it needs strap.py reopen (round 3), a new round the developer decides on. Fold into the next reopen.
